source_manifest.source_policy: Only exact committed Git blobs named below are admissible. Working-tree bytes, generated mirrors, agent consensus, and worktree replay carriers are excluded.

value.expires_when: Its declared intake window closes unless a Data object is created.
value.name: Signal
value.object_definition: A sensed, voiced, clicked, or streamed event before an admitted semantic structure.

value.expires_when: Its retention purpose or service window ends unless a structured successor is created.
value.name: Data
value.object_definition: Addressable bytes with content identity, size, time, source boundary, and retention state; still semantically mute.

value.expires_when: Its usefulness or rights basis expires and no cited claim depends on it.
value.name: Information
value.object_definition: Data plus an explicit schema, transformation, interpretation boundary, and provenance trail.

value.expires_when: It is revoked, contradicted, unsupported, or superseded; the predecessor record remains traceable.
value.name: Knowledge
value.object_definition: A typed proposition linked to admitted Information, explicit warrant, confidence, rivals, and defeaters; not truth by label.

value.expires_when: The decision is revoked or superseded; the audit receipt remains under applicable retention law.
value.name: Judgment
value.object_definition: Knowledge joined to a scoped decision by a named bearer, with authority state, reversibility, cost, and expected consequence visible.
writers: agent only within an already valid charter

value.expires_when: It is contested, superseded, retracted, or its mandate ends; lineage remains visible where lawful.
value.name: Wisdom
value.object_definition: A reusable, versioned policy distilled from Judgment with scope, outcome evidence, rivals, kills, correction lineage, and authority boundary.
writers: named policy bearer under separate authority

requirements: bind source, time, rights, and retention
cite admitted sources and expose warrant, rivals, and defeaters
record a scoped decision by a named bearer
bind authority state, cost, reversibility, and expected consequence
derive a reusable policy without erasing the Judgment
bind independent outcomes, scope, rivals, kills, correction, and policy authority

bearer_ledgers.consent: worldview adoption is never required to inspect or contribute

bearer_ledgers.preservation: access to sources, rivals, kills, corrections, and genuine Exit

bearer_ledgers.consent: no proxy mandate or public consent is manufactured by the Compact
bearer_ledgers.creation: visible authorization, consequence, and correction boundaries
bearer_ledgers.destruction: possible delay where urgent action is justified
bearer_ledgers.exit: separately applicable rights, deletion duties, withdrawal, and challenge remain controlling

clauses: Keep possibility wide; make commitment accountable.
Preserve ancestry; correction creates a successor rather than silently overwriting.
Capability, intelligence, popularity, product position, or consensus grants no authority.
Keep proposal, Judgment, authorization, execution, receipt, outcome, and revision distinct.
Count creation, destruction, and preservation separately by bearer and horizon; never hide them inside one unsupported scalar.
Publicity begins another feedback loop: reach is not truth, and correction, contestability, and Exit remain available.
value.compression: Keep possibility wide. Make commitment accountable. Nothing promotes itself. Reality retains the right to correct every map.
value.epistemic_type: chosen editorial policy with empirical support debt
kill_criteria: supersede or narrow the policy if it systematically blocks justified action, hides real authority, or makes correction harder
retract any clause that preserves harmful data against valid privacy, deletion, revocation, contract, or legal duties
do not promote to SUPPORTED unless admitted independent outcomes beat named simpler controls on error detection, correction, reversibility, or bearer protection
value.proposition: A public reasoning practice should preserve source ancestry, separate promotion and consequence states, expose authority and bearer ledgers, and remain correctable after publication.
value.public_digest: A compact for turning ideas into accountable, revisable guidance without confusing visibility, consensus, capability, or receipts with truth or authority.
rivals: ordinary source criticism, audit trails, version control, decision journals, and scientific peer review may supply the same discipline with less vocabulary
a faster risk-proportionate process may outperform the full stack for reversible low-consequence work
value.scope: Emergentism editorial, research, and public-projection practice only
value.state_note: Locally authorized for the Emergentism v3 candidate; not lit, externally validated, product-adopted, or Supported.
value.title: The Public Wisdom Compact

value.candidate_application: Emergentism uses the stack to keep raw arrivals, structured maps, claims, editorial Judgments, reusable policy, and public projection source-separated while the Soul Loop returns consequence to revision.
value.name: Emergentism
value.survivor_if_rejected: The cited sources, ordinary versioning, native audit practices, and correction records remain.

value.candidate_application: APU may be read as a bounded intake and gate surface that keeps untrusted arrivals below durable claim or decision status until explicit checks and promotion events occur.
value.name: APU
value.survivor_if_rejected: APU's native gate specification and source ownership remain unchanged.

value.candidate_application: Circle may preserve sourced observations and reported claims as provenance-bearing Information while refusing to manufacture cause, likelihood, recommendation, decision, or outcome; any public field remains a separate projection.
value.name: Circle / IS
value.survivor_if_rejected: Circle's sourced-IS boundary and correction chain remain authoritative in its own lane.

value.candidate_application: RealityFutures may transform sourced Information into uncertainty-bearing forecasts and calibration records without promoting COULD into IS, SHOULD, Judgment, authority, or execution; resolution evidence returns through a separate loop.
value.name: RealityFutures / COULD
value.survivor_if_rejected: RealityFutures retains its native forecast, uncertainty, calibration, and ownership boundaries.

value.candidate_application: Agentz may compile sourced IS and uncertainty-bearing COULD into an unsigned SHOULD proposal while keeping proposal distinct from the Judgment, mandate, execution, receipt, and independent outcome that only later bearers may supply.
value.name: Agentz / SHOULD
value.survivor_if_rejected: Agentz remains a non-authorizing decision compiler under its own Applied Rosetta boundary.

value.candidate_application: Skyzai's whole-boundary may be read as a non-authorizing constraint and coherence check around Judgment and policy reuse; HOLD, RETURN, or PASS cannot become approval, signing authority, execution, or evidence of outcome.
value.name: Skyzai constraint boundary
value.survivor_if_rejected: Skyzai's native constraint dispositions and external-authority firewall remain.

value.candidate_application: Menexus may render the stack as an explanatory promotion lens over typed records: Cortex preserves accepted lineage, AIA requests or explains bounded transformations, and Nexus carries scoped views; none of the seven labels becomes a folder, domain type, truth rank, or authority source.
value.name: Menexus / Cortex · AIA · Nexus
value.survivor_if_rejected: Menexus retains its native commitment kernel, domain kinds, promotion states, retention, visibility, and external-authority separation.

value.candidate_application: Evolutionary.Network may test whether selected guidance survives voluntary seven-function practice in the actual world, returning independent consequence rather than self-certification; the Ventures network and Skyzai L1 organ remain distinct source owners.

value.survivor_if_rejected: The selected people-network charter, functions-not-ranks fence, and separate Skyzai organ remain unchanged.
